requirements.text: Students should be able to assign colours to their modules to easily differentiate between core and elective courses.
Students should be able to toggle the visibility of cancelled classes in their timetable to reduce clutter.
Students should be able to add personal study blocks with reminders to help them manage their time effectively.
A combination of push notifications and emails should be provided for immediate and backup alerts for grades and deadlines.
Grade notifications should be sent within five minutes after a grade is posted.
Assignment and exam reminders should be sent at multiple intervals: one week prior, one day before, and a couple of hours before the due time.
Students should have the option to configure their notification preferences regarding frequency and channels.
The module feedback system should include questions on content quality, delivery, resources, overall experience, and open-ended feedback.
Feedback should be shared with module coordinators only after grades are submitted to ensure anonymity.
The system must integrate seamlessly with the existing portal without requiring students to create new accounts or install additional software.
The performance of the portal must remain robust and responsive after the introduction of new features.
All new features must comply with GDPR and the university's data retention policies to protect student data.
